# Pitex 1.1.7

This release fixes bugs. Most of them could lose your edits without
warning.

## Fixes

- Quitting or closing no longer hangs when a file has an unresolved
  external-change conflict. Pitex asks whether to Keep Mine, Use
  External or Cancel.
- Edits are no longer lost when you choose Save and Close while typing,
  or when you open a new project file on Linux and Windows.
- In SSH projects, pulling no longer overwrites a mirror copy you
  changed, and a case-only rename no longer deletes it.
- Build → Clean removes only build output files.
- Saving keeps a file's permissions.
- Read-only files show a clear message and keep your edits.
- A stalled assistant can no longer freeze the app.
- Saving a Markdown or other non-TeX file in an SSH project no longer
  starts a LaTeX build.
- Other stability fixes.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 through 1.1.6 update to 1.1.7 from Settings or, with automatic
installation enabled, at launch. For Homebrew installations, run
`brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask pitex`.

Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.1.7
from the downloads below. Pitex Nightly continues to use its separate
update channel.

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and
SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
